why: Instrument defect found while building, before any measured run: P3 claims that no law, record or model names Wiper's model, but the test read every file under laws/<M>/, including the milestone's index DERIVATION.json, whose inputs list (every file derive read, by sha256) and the codec layer's uncovered list (every transitions document with no codec component: Q62's empty layer) name the opaque document as a read input, not as a law. The test now checks the law files and records as before, and in DERIVATION.json and REGISTRY.json their laws entries (each law's facts and basis model); the inputs and uncovered lists are provenance and stay as derive writes them. The claim and every other assertion are unchanged.

Found by I112 while building, before any measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says the protocols before I111 name no types_fallback, so I111's opt-in reaches no earlier key's record. It globbed every spec/M[4-6]/lib/i*_run.json except i111_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I112's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i112_run.json, I111's plus four opt-ins) carries I111's types_fallback by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I111 and later keys (an iteration field I111 or above), as I111 amended I110's test_r3. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the claim is unchanged.
